decisive_spans.text: CT and MRI of the head revealed a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe

response.rationale: The patient's persistent headache and the presence of a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe are direct evidence for leptomeningeal metastasis. While the patient has a history of epilepsy and a mass lesion, which supports D3, the headache and mass are more directly indicative of leptomeningeal metastasis.
